description: Power of examiner.mk_hamed_rao (lag=3) on monthly series with a known positive linear trend, seasonal cycle and stationary AR(1) noise, through trendcourt.benchmark.run_case. 'rejection' is the share with p < alpha; 'detection' the share with p < alpha and z > 0 (the injected direction). Where the test is liberal on trend-free noise (docs/benchmark/fpr.json), these rates overstate power.

series.sigma_meaning: stationary standard deviation of the AR(1) noise
series.slope_units: noise SDs per decade (sigma = 1, so also units of the series per decade)

seeds.scheme: numpy.random.default_rng((master, round(1000 * phi), round(1000 * slope), n_years, replicate))
